items: Gimbal protector off. Arms and propellers unfolded and secure.
Aircraft battery, remote and phone charged.
Lenses and sensors clean. Nothing blocking the motors.
DJI Fly connected.
Obstacle avoidance action set. Max Altitude, Max Distance and Auto RTH Altitude set for local rules.
Take off from open, flat ground with the rear of the drone facing you.

blocks.text: Never launch from your hand. Don't fly in rain, snow or strong wind.

Use

Fast; obstacle avoidance OFF; needs 40 m to stop

blocks.text: With weak GPS and no vision system the drone drops to ATTI mode: it drifts in wind and won't hover by itself. Land soon.

rows: Half-press to focus, full press to shoot
Camera dial: zoom, or EV, shutter, ISO
Hold custom button + gimbal dial to zoom

blocks.text: Both remotes have the C/N/S switch and a **Flight Pause/RTH** button.

head: Mode
What it does
rows: Camera stays on the subject while you fly
Follows people (4–20 m) or vehicles and boats (6–100 m)
Flies a set of classic shots automatically
One preset move, makes a short clip
Repeatable saved route with camera actions

items: Start them from the Shooting Modes icon (right of the camera view) or the FocusTrack icon (left).
They need decent light (above 5 lux, below 100,000 lux) and fail on snow, sand or subjects that blend in.
QuickShots space: Boomerang needs 30 m around and 10 m above; Asteroid needs 40 m behind and 50 m above.
Flight Pause on the remote stops any mode and hovers.
**Follow** mode keeps the horizon level. **FPV** mode rolls with the drone. Set in DJI Fly › Control.
Single Shot uses SmartPhoto (scene detection, HDR). There's no HDR when the drone is moving, in strong wind, or in Pro mode.
Don't point the camera at the sun for long, or at lasers.
Focus can struggle with distant dark subjects, repeating patterns, reflections and fast movement.
Triggered by you, by low battery, or by lost signal.
The Home Point is recorded at take-off; DJI Fly announces it. Update it in Safety if you move.
Set the RTH altitude above trees and buildings before you fly.
QuickTransfer to your phone.
USB-C cable to a computer (the drone can stay off).
Or take out the microSD card. Never remove it while recording.
